title: 14 加入15 青铜血石与复脸蟾蜍
slug: 在诡异世界变成蜘蛛精
content_zh:
：“嗯？”
邹平司刚刚放下的心瞬间又提起来了，立刻忍不住转头看向贺堪，试图看出他这是一时说错话了。
“什么意思？”
眼看贺堪完全没有收回这句话的意思，邹平司眉头邹忍不住皱起来了：“难道说你在意的是谢平平院子里没有足够的保护，还是覃门房这件事情对监天司产生的防备？”
“覃门房这件事情我可以保证与仪征司无关，安插他进来的人具体是谁，即使是我也不清楚，只能模糊知道是来自大朝城的人。”
邹平司耐心的开口解释，他是真的看好贺堪的未来，不希望对方因为一时之气放弃自己的未来。
大朝城，是夏朝的都城，上皇、权贵、乃至数不清的世家大族都在这座庞大到无与伦比的城池，自然也包括监天司的总府衙。
说白了，监天司在这个偏僻荒芜的大启城算得上一手遮天，人人敬畏，城中世家权贵纷纷避让，可换到大朝城，嘿，权力还真没那么大。
所以邹平司说不知道也是真的不知道。
这个时候，邹平司就十分想念在外面巡游的老大了，老大一走，大启城这个犄角旮旯什么妖魔鬼怪都蹦出来了，监天司内部也不安稳，邹平司只感觉有一双无形的手在背后操弄，以前老大在的时候，什么覃老头，覃门房的，不管你背景有多厚，实力有多强，想要插手监天司内部，只有一个答案，滚。
老大还能反手将这个要求甩到对方脸上。
不要说世家大族了，就算是上皇，老大都能去皇宫告状。
邹平司心里忍不住重重叹口气，可谁让老大走了呢，大启城监天司剩下的三瓜两枣的小狗小猫，只能勉强支撑，不是每个人都和老大一样有背景，丝毫不虚任何世家大族权贵们的压力。
原本覃门房这事邹平司也是不同意，然而，对方退而求其次，不进入监天司反而成为门房，邹平司有心想看对方搞什么名堂，这才同意。
没想到目的竟然是这个。
邹平司抬头看了眼不远处一脸无害微笑的黑发青年，一时间感觉头疼无比。
“不要因一时之气而放弃资源。”
邹平司顿了顿，难得语气温和的开口解释，他试图劝说贺堪回心转意，小贺村他是知道了，大启城监天司管下面每个村落的术师与诡士，有些村落的术师死亡后，大启城监天司还会派新的术师过去接替。
小贺村在这些村落中都算是贫穷的，唯一的术师还是个老术师，资质平平，画的符箓只能说勉强能用，这样的条件，邹平司看来，贺堪回小贺村完全就是在糟蹋自己的天赋。
“邹司士觉得我是那样无聊的人吗？”

贺堪没有答应什么，只是抬眼反问了一句，他自认为从进入监天司后表现出来的绝不是冲动的人。
“………”
邹平司一顿，不说话了。
的确，贺堪从来不是这种鲁莽的人。
邹平司也觉得怪异，不过他以为是愤怒占据了上风，贺堪这才决定回老家，现在看来，还有别的原因。
“那你是……？”
邹平司犹豫了一会儿，斟酌道。
“因为我在监天司继续待下去遇到的事情只会更麻烦。”
贺堪轻笑了一声，语气平淡的开口：“覃门房背后的人，商队首领背后的人，目前监天司根本找不出对方，踪迹难觅，这只能说明一种情况，对方与监天司关系匪浅。”
“所以你们在大朝城以及其他城池监天司的力量受到阻碍。”
贺堪十分平静的指出邹平司话语中的漏洞。
一开始，贺堪说出待在监天司更麻烦这句话的时候，邹平司眉头一皱，似乎有些想要反驳，随后，他就听见了贺堪的解释。
邹平司想要说话的动作一顿，重新坐回座上。
因为贺堪的推测也正是邹平司自己的推测，这也是为什么邹平司想念老大的原因，有些事情，其他人都不能查，只有大统领戚昭明可以。
贺堪的遇袭是因为上面的一股力量想要杀了他。
贺堪看见邹平司的动作，表情满意，看来邹平司真的不是想要害他的那股势力里的人，很可能还与那股力量为敌，这就好了。
“第二：我已经在监天司测过天赋，来大启城最重要的目的已经完成。”
贺堪又竖起一根手指，开口说道：“儒子阁的王老说，每个人的天赋都需要自己来摸索，旁人给不了经验，我没必要继续留下来学习。”
“回小贺村也是一样的。”
“至于第三嘛——”

贺堪看邹平司一直默默的听他说话，也不主动开口了，说到第三的时候，语气还微微拉长——
邹平司抬头看向了他。
“第三：是关于我的天赋的。”
贺堪没有继续玩笑了，一反之前有些懒散的态度，表情十分认真的说道。

: "Huh?"
Zou Pingsi's heart that had just been relieved suddenly rose again, and he couldn't help but turn to look at He Kan, trying to see that he had said the wrong thing for a moment.
"What do you mean?"
Seeing that He Kan had no intention of taking back his words, Zou Pingsi couldn't help but frown: "Could it be that what you care about is the lack of adequate protection in Xie Pingping's yard, or the fact that Concierge Tan's incident has caused Jian Tiansi to be on guard?"
"I can guarantee that the matter of Concierge Tan has nothing to do with the Yizheng Division. Even I don't know who the person who put him in is. I can only vaguely know that he is from Dachao City."
Zoupingsi patiently explained that he was really optimistic about He Kan's future and did not want the other party to give up on his future just because of anger.
Dachao City was the capital of the Xia Dynasty. The emperor, dignitaries, and even countless aristocratic families were all in this huge and unparalleled city, including the general office of Supervisor Tiansi.
To put it bluntly, Supervisor Tiansi can be regarded as one-handed in this remote and desolate Daqi City. Everyone is in awe of him, and the powerful families in the city have shunned him. But in Dachao City, hey, the power is really not that great.
So when Zoupingsi said he didn't know, he really didn't know.
At this time, Zoupingsi missed the boss who was patrolling outside very much. As soon as the boss left, all kinds of monsters and monsters popped up in the nooks and crannies of Daqicheng. The inside of Jiantiansi was not stable. Zoupingsi only felt that there was a pair of invisible hands manipulating behind his back. When the boss was here, old man Qin or the concierge Qin, no matter how rich your background and strength were, if you wanted to get involved in Jiantiansi, there was only one answer, get out.
The boss can also backhand this request to the opponent's face.
Not to mention aristocratic families, even the emperor and the boss can go to the palace to complain.
Zoupingsi couldn't help but sigh heavily in his heart, but who let the boss go? The three melons and two dates left by Daqi City Supervisor Tiansi's remaining puppies and kittens could only barely support themselves. Not everyone had the same background as the boss, and they did not live up to the pressure of any powerful family.
Originally, Zou Pingsi did not agree with the matter of Tan's porter. However, the other party settled for the next best thing and became the porter instead of joining Jian Tiansi. Zoupingsi wanted to see what the other party could do, so he agreed.
I didn't expect that the purpose turned out to be this.
Zoupingsi raised his head and glanced at the black-haired young man with a harmless smile not far away, and felt a headache for a moment.
“Don’t give up resources in the heat of the moment.”
Zouping Si paused and explained in a rare gentle tone. He tried to persuade He Kan to change his mind. He knew about Xiaohe Village. Daqi City Supervisor Tiansi was responsible for the magicians and sorcerers in each village below. After the magicians in some villages died, Daqi City Supervisor Tiansi would send new magicians to take over.
Xiaohe Village is considered poor among these villages. The only magician is an old magician with mediocre qualifications. The talismans he draws can only be said to be barely usable. Under such conditions, Zou Pingsi thinks that He Kan is completely wasting his talent by returning to Xiaohe Village.
"Does Master Zou think I'm such a boring person?"
He Kan didn't agree to anything, he just raised his eyes and asked. He believed that he was by no means an impulsive person after entering the Supervisory Sky Division.
"..."
Zoupingsi paused and stopped talking.
Indeed, He Kan has never been such a reckless person.
Zoupingsi also felt strange, but he thought it was anger that took over, and He Kan decided to return to his hometown. Now it seems that there are other reasons.
"Then you are...?"
Zoupingsi hesitated for a while and then considered.
"Because if I continue to stay in Tiantiansi, the things I will encounter will only become more troublesome."
He Kan chuckled lightly and said in a calm tone: "The person behind Concierge Tan, the person behind the leader of the caravan, Jian Tiansi can't find him at all at present, and his traces are hard to find. This can only mean that the other party has a close relationship with Jian Tiansi."
"So you are in Dachao City and other placesThe power of the City Supervisor Tiansi was hindered. "
He Kan pointed out the loopholes in Zoupingsi's words very calmly.
At first, when He Kan said that it would be more troublesome to stay in Jiantiansi, Zoupingsi frowned, as if he wanted to refute. Then, he heard He Kan's explanation.
Zoupingsi paused when he wanted to speak and sat back down.
Because He Kan's speculation was also Zoupingsi's own speculation, which is why Zoupingsi misses his boss. There are some things that no one else can investigate, only the commander-in-chief Qi Zhaoming can.
He Kan was attacked because a force from above wanted to kill him.
He Kan saw Zoupingsi's actions with a satisfied expression. It seemed that Zoupingsi was really not a member of the force that wanted to harm him, and was probably an enemy of that force. That was good.
"Second: I have already tested my talent in Tiantian Division, and the most important purpose of coming to Daqi City has been completed. "
He Kan raised another finger and said, "Mr. Wang from Confucian Pavilion said that everyone's talent needs to be explored by themselves. Others can't give them experience, so there is no need for me to stay and learn. "
“The same goes back to Xiaohe Village. "
"As for the third one——"
He Kan saw that Zou Pingsi had been listening to him silently and did not take the initiative to speak. When he reached the third word, his tone was slightly longer——
Zoupingsi looked up at him.
“Third: It’s about my talent. "
He Kan stopped joking and said with a very serious expression, contrary to his previous lazy attitude.
